facts.statement: The study asks how transient electrical connections are removed as neural circuits mature.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The researchers studied the PLM mechanosensory neurons of the worm Caenorhabditis elegans to observe synaptic changes.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Blocking early electrical connections stopped calcium waves and prevented chemical synapses from forming, but fixing the calcium waves alone fixed the chemical synapse problem.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: A genetic screen found that the UNC-51 kinase is necessary for removing these temporary electrical connections.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The UNC-51 protein modifies UNC-76 to help transport and remove the innexin proteins that build electrical synapses.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: When this removal pathway is broken, electrical synapses stay active and the neurons become overly excited.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The authors suggest this mechanism provides a general model for how temporary electrical links are removed during development.
facts.subject: other
